Package com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update

Class InstallLocation

java.lang.Object
com.protonmail.landrevillejf.swingide.update.InstallLocation
public final class InstallLocation extends Object
Locates the root of an installed Project Looking Glass release bundle.

lg3d is not a single JAR: :lg3d-core:releaseBundle ships a directory tree (lib/ with every module + third-party jar, resources/, etc/, ext/app/, the lg3d.sh launcher, README.txt and VERSION) launched from a classpath. The update-manager jar lives at <root>/lib/update-manager-*.jar, so the install root is the grand-parent of the running jar. This class resolves that root and validates the layout, so the bundle installer knows which tree to replace.

The jar-path supplier and the property lookup are injected so the whole detection can be unit tested without running from a real bundle.

  • Method Details

    • detect

      public Optional<Path> detect()
      Resolves the bundle install root, if the desktop runs from one.

      The explicit "lg3d.install.dir" property wins when it points at a valid bundle; otherwise the root is derived from the running jar (<root>/lib/<jar>). A development launch (Gradle classes dir, no bundle layout) yields Optional.empty(), so callers can fall back on the legacy single-jar path.

      Returns:
      the install root, or empty when not running from a release bundle
